title: kith-tui: handle cannotCalculateChanges
description: RFC 8620 s5.2: /changes fails with cannotCalculateChanges when it cannot compute from sinceState; client must resync via /get. kith-tui only falls back on stateMismatch (an ifInState error, s5.3). With an empty chat it sends sinceState 's-0', testjig returns cannotCalculateChanges, and new messages never appear.
